Repo: /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/amz-free-shiping
State file: /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/amz-free-shiping/.agent/mission-state.json

## Mission Loop — unified autonomous cycle

### STEP 1 — Watchdog
Run: REPO_PATH=/home/ubuntu/.openclaw/workspace/amz-free-shiping python3 /home/ubuntu/.openclaw/scripts/babysitter_watchdog.py
- status=OK: continue silently.
- status=WARN or STALE: send Telegram alert (branch, ticket, head, summary), then continue.

### STEP 2 — Service health
Verify: curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:8085/health AND curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:8002/api/health
If either is down: run bash scripts/auto-launch.sh. If still down after launch: send alert and abort this cycle entirely.

### STEP 3 — Per-PR mission loop
Load state from .agent/mission-state.json (keyed by PR number). For every open non-draft PR:

[A] GUARD — check PR is still open
  Re-fetch PR state. If merged or closed: call Linear API to transition the linked ticket to Done. Remove from state. Skip to next PR.

[B] GUARD — dirty workspace
  Before touching any branch: verify `git status --short` is clean in the repo.
  If dirty: stash changes or send HUMAN-NEEDED. Never switch branches with uncommitted changes.

[C] SHA CURRENCY — is CodeRabbit up to date?
  Get current HEAD SHA for the PR (gh pr view N --json headRefOid).
  Get latest CodeRabbit review and check its commit_id field.
  - If no CR review exists for current HEAD SHA: this is a new push CR hasn't seen yet.
    Post "@coderabbitai review" ONLY if state.last_review_request_sha != HEAD SHA.
    Save last_review_request_sha = HEAD SHA. Stop processing this PR this cycle — wait for CR.
  - If CR review exists for current HEAD SHA: proceed to [D].

[D] STALE COMMENT FILTER
  Fetch all CR inline comments. Discard any where position == null — these are outdated (code changed around them) and must not be acted on.

[E] ACTIONABLE ASSESSMENT
  Parse actionable count from latest CR review body (regex "Actionable comments posted: N").
  - null (CR still generating): skip this PR this cycle, wait.
  - > 0 OR non-null inline comments remain: go to [G] IMPLEMENT CR FIXES.
  - 0 AND zero non-null inline comments: go to [F] TICKET CHECK.

[F] TICKET CHECK — is the mission actually done?
  Extract ticket ID from branch name (regex ITZ-\d+) or .agent/branch-map.json.
  Fetch from Linear: title, description, acceptance criteria, current state.
  - If ticket state is Done or Cancelled: skip. No work needed.
  - Compare acceptance criteria against current branch code carefully.
  - If ALL criteria are met:
    Notify: CAN MERGE — PR #N (ITZ-XX complete). UI: http://20.240.201.161:8002 and http://20.240.201.161:8002/admin
    Save last_merge_ready_sha = HEAD SHA. Transition Linear ticket to In Review if not already.
  - If criteria NOT fully met: go to [H] IMPLEMENT TICKET SCOPE.

[G] IMPLEMENT CR FIXES
  Checkout PR branch, pull latest.
  Check for divergence from main: if behind, attempt `git rebase origin/main`. If conflicts: send HUMAN-NEEDED (branch, conflicting files). Do not push.
  Implement all concrete CR fixes (actionable inline comments with non-null position) in one batch commit.
  Run validations:
  - `go test ./...` if any backend file touched
  - `npm run build` if any frontend file touched
  If validation fails: DO NOT push. Send HUMAN-NEEDED with exact error output (file, line, message).
  If passing: commit + push.
  Post "@coderabbitai review" only if new HEAD SHA != state.last_review_request_sha.
  Save last_review_request_sha = new HEAD SHA.
  Save same_actionable_cycles = 0.
  Health check after push: curl both endpoints. If down: run auto-launch.sh, alert.

[H] IMPLEMENT TICKET SCOPE (CR clean but mission incomplete)
  Checkout PR branch, pull latest.
  Work through unimplemented acceptance criteria one at a time.
  Run validations: go test ./... and npm run build.
  If failing: DO NOT push. Send HUMAN-NEEDED.
  If passing: commit + push with message "feat(ITZ-XX): <what was implemented>".
  Post "@coderabbitai review" only if new HEAD SHA != state.last_review_request_sha.
  Save last_review_request_sha = new HEAD SHA.
  Health check after push.

[I] ESCALATION — stuck actionable
  If same actionable count persists for same SHA across 3+ cycles (same_actionable_cycles >= 3):
  Send HUMAN-NEEDED: PR number, exact file + line + CR comment text, reason agent is blocked.
  Set escalated = true. Do not retry until SHA changes.
  If actionable changes or SHA changes: reset same_actionable_cycles = 0, escalated = false.

[J] SAVE STATE
  Write updated per-PR state back to .agent/mission-state.json:
  {
    last_head_sha, last_cr_review_sha, last_review_request_sha,
    last_merge_ready_sha, actionable, same_actionable_cycles,
    escalated, ticket_id, ticket_state
  }

### STEP 4 — No open PRs (Linear-driven new work)
  Query Linear for tickets in In Progress state.
  For each: check if a branch or PR matching ITZ-{id} already exists before creating one.
  If no branch/PR exists: create branch ITZ-{id}-{slug}, implement initial scaffold based on ticket description + acceptance criteria, open draft PR.
  If no In Progress tickets: true NOOP — stay silent.

## Output policy
- Silent on full NOOP (nothing changed, services healthy, watchdog OK).
- Speak only for: fix pushed, ticket impl pushed, human-needed, can-merge, watchdog alert, service down, new branch started, ticket marked done.
- All non-NOOP events → Telegram to 347830791.
